name: Bojayá (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of light blue and dark green, the light blue with a white canton at the fly bearing a ring of black five-pointed stars.
history: Municipal flag of Bojayá, a municipality in the department of Chocó, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: white rectangle at the upper fly
ring of stars on the white rectangle
